eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 12:08 PM on AUG 30, 2021 Effective until 12:08 PM AUG 31, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an evacuation warning for North of Hwy 70 from Sloat Cromberg area east to Nervino Airport Please make preparations to evacuate If you have special needs you should evacuate now If you have large animals make arrangements to move them immediately More alerts may be sent with new information
